fields.title: Exterior retention, moisture and wet optics
fields.finding: The 0.1 kg/m2 external water debit and material drying assumptions remain projections. Thermal reconciliation does not establish a dry-exterior operational limit or permit removing those masses.
fields.needed: Measure retention/conditioning and wet optical performance; preserve all existing debit and equipment qualifications.
